entities.name: Johan
entities.description: A powerful, evil red mage and shapeshifter, Tyrant of Tirras, who tried to conquer Jamuraa and died eaten by a sand wurm.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: The western continent Johan tried to conquer.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: The mountain-bound northern land ruled by Johan, whose people survive by raiding along the River Toloron.

entities.name: Hazezon Tamar
entities.description: Johan's rival who bested him twice, learned to shift, supervised the skyship fleet, and later governed Bryce.

entities.name: Jaeger Ojanen
entities.description: The tiger man father of Jedit, who led an army against Johan at Palmyra and was killed by a sand wurm.

entities.name: Jedit Ojanen
entities.description: The tiger man son of Jaeger whom Johan manipulated, and who later charged Johan and became leader of the reunited tiger tribes.

entities.name: Adira Strongheart
entities.description: A Robaran Mercenary imprisoned by Johan and later killed by him in the final battle.

entities.name: Robaran Mercenaries
entities.description: Mercenaries who spied on Johan, were captured, and later explored islands in the name of their fallen leader Adira.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: A vampire who lured Johan to her fortress to enslave him.

entities.name: Hestia
entities.description: An Efravan who accompanied Johan and Jedit around the oasis.

entities.name: Efrava
entities.description: An oasis in the Sukurvian desert where Johan met Jedit and where the final battle was fought.

entities.name: Palmyra
entities.description: The site where Johan's first attempt was stalled by Hazezon and Jaeger.

entities.name: Bryce
entities.description: A city-state south of Tirras that Johan warred with and which Hazezon later governed.

entities.name: Sukurvian Desert
entities.description: A desert home to cat warrior tribes and sand wurms, and the junction between the continents.

entities.name: Johan's War
entities.description: Johan's attempted conquest of Jamuraa, ending in the battle at Efrava.

entities.name: Icewind
entities.description: Johan's flagship skyship in the final battle.

entities.name: Adira's Kite
entities.description: Hazezon's flagship, said to have explored the ocean to the far ends of the Domains.

entities.name: Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
entities.description: A place rebuilt in the Scarwood by the reunited tiger tribes.

events.summary: Johan becomes Tyrant of Tirras and proclaims himself Emperor of the Northern Realm, warring with city-states south of Tirras.
events.quote: His first step was becoming Tyrant of Tirras , and proclaiming himself "Emperor of the Northern Realm".

events.summary: Johan's army is stalled at Palmyra by Hazezon and Jaeger and disperses in a magical sandstorm; Jaeger is killed by a sand wurm.
events.quote: his army ended up dispersing due to a magical sandstorm conjured by Hazezon .

events.summary: Disguised as a human, Johan reaches Efrava and uses a charm to manipulate Jedit into pleading to be his guardian.
events.quote: he used his mental control of Jedit to have him plead to be his guardian.

events.summary: Johan's treachery is discovered; he kills Efravan guards and flees west with Jedit in pursuit.
events.quote: Johan killed a couple of Efravan guards to escape to the desert

events.summary: Shauku lures Johan to her fortress to enslave him but he escapes and decides to enslave the cat warrior tribes.
events.quote: it turned out to be a plot to enslave him in her service.

events.summary: Johan captures the Robaran Mercenaries, but Hazezon shifts away and the city-states build a skyship fleet.
events.quote: Unbeknownst to him, Hazezon had learned to shift (to teleport) and was, therefore, able to escape.

events.summary: In the final battle at Efrava, Johan turns Hazezon's spell against him and tears out Adira's heart.
events.quote: he killed Adira Strongheart by ripping her heart out of her chest with his bare hands.

events.summary: Jedit charges Johan and they fall overboard; Johan is eaten by a sand wurm, as Jaeger had been.
events.quote: Johan died the same way Jaeger Ojanen had: eaten by a sand wurm .

events.summary: With Johan dead, his generals turn on each other and the fleet flees; stranded troops surrender and Hazezon escorts them to Tirras.
events.quote: Hazezon Tamar would take pity on them and escort them back to their homeland of Tirras .

events.summary: Peace follows Johan's death; Hazezon governs Bryce then vanishes with a skyship fleet, and Jedit leads the reunited tiger tribes to the Scarwood.
events.quote: The death of Johan ushered in an era of peace and prosperity in Jamuraa

relations.note: His only rival, who bested him twice.
relations.quote: his only rival might have been Hazezon Tamar , who bested him twice.

relations.note: Killed her in the final battle.
relations.quote: he killed Adira Strongheart by ripping her heart out of her chest with his bare hands.
Johan , Tyrant of Tirras and Emperor of the Northern Realms
The vampire lured him with the promise of information on the tiger man's origins

relations.note: Led the army that stalled Johan at Palmyra together.
relations.quote: an army led by Hazezon Tamar and Jaeger Ojanen

relations.note: Imprisoned together by Johan and later allied.
relations.quote: imprisoning Hazezon Tamar and Adira Strongheart in a room without a door or window.
